_readme: GridPilot verified equipment library. Every parameter written into generated
documents (especially 03 Attachment A) must come from this file and carry a
source. Fields listed in 'sourced_keys' are verified against the cited
source; fields in 'assumed_keys' are engineering defaults pending a source —
the app raises a SYSTEM ADMIN alert for them and never writes them into
Attachment A. To clear an alert: find the value in an OEM document, move the
key from assumed_keys to sourced_keys, update the value, and note the source

sungrow_sg4400ud_mv.datasheet: Sungrow SG4400UD-MV-US Turnkey Station Datasheet (official US variant)

source.title: Sungrow SG4400UD-MV-US Datasheet — Turnkey Station for 1500 Vdc System, MV Transformer Integrated (en.sungrowpower.com product page 4132)

source_notes.mva: US variant: AC output power 4400 kVA @ 40 C (optional 4400 kVA @ 45 C); transformer rated = max power 4400 kVA — SG4400UD-MV-US datasheet. (International SG4400UD-MV lists 4532 kVA @ 40 C; do not mix variants.)
source_notes.mw: kW = kVA at unity PF; datasheet power factor at nominal power > 0.99
source_notes.pf_range: Adjustable power factor 0.8 leading - 0.8 lagging — datasheet
source_notes.ac_kv: Nominal terminal voltage: integrated transformer LV winding 0.645 kV (inverter AC terminal); MV output 34.5 kV — SG4400UD-MV-US datasheet 'Transformer' (LV / MV voltage 0.645 kV / 34.5 kV)
source_notes.q_pu_max: At 0.8 PF and rated kVA: Q/S = sin(acos(0.8)) = 0.6 — derived from the sourced PF range
source_notes.integrated_xfmr.vector: Dy1 (optional: Dy11, Yny0, YNd1) — SG4400UD-MV-US datasheet
source_notes.integrated_xfmr.z_pct: Transformer impedance 8% (0 ~ +/-10%) @ 4400 kVA — SG4400UD-MV family datasheet
source_notes.integrated_xfmr.xr: ASSUMED 9.5 per developer 'Generation site design' workbook GSU section — X/R not published; ADMIN: confirm with Sungrow
source_notes.fault_current_pu: ASSUMED 1.25 — not in the public datasheet; ADMIN: request OEM short-circuit contribution letter
source_notes.dyd_params: Generic WECC parameter set — replaced by the vendor .dyd (MOD-026/027) when uploaded
